article.title: Hundreds flood popular Ibiza beach in protest against tourists
article.summary: ANTI-TOURISM protests are flaring up in Spain with the latest stunt seeing more than 100 protestors flood an "overcrowded" beach in Ibiza. Furious locals held up banners in Catalan and English which read: "Wherever you look, it's all tourists". Organised by the Ibiza Youth Association, the demonstration swept across a small sandy cove called Cala...

article.title: Greek paradise beach is branded 'hell on Earth' as video shows beauty spot so packed tourists are barely able to walk ashore from ferry
article.summary: A picturesque beach in Greece has been dubbed 'hell on earth' after it was overrun by a mass of tourists.

article.title: Anti-tourism activists descend on ‘overcrowded’ beach at iconic vacation destination for partygoers
article.summary: Thanks to social media, European summer destinations have become more visible than ever, funneling into the same handful of destinations, streets, restaurants and viewpoints.
